parties: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited; Urvashi Tilakdhar (acquirer/discloser)
headline: Urvashi Tilakdhar files SEBI Regulation 10(5) substantial shareholding disclosure in DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals
sum: Substantial acquisition disclosure filed under SEBI Takeover Regulations. Urvashi Tilakdhar submitted a formal Regulation 10(5) disclosure to NSE, indicating a triggering shareholding event (likely 5% or greater acquisition of voting rights) in DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure marks the crossing of a 5% disclosure threshold and may trigger open offer requirements under Regulation 11 if conditions are met; counsel must review acquirer intent, timing of full details, and any exemptions sought.
detail: The filing by Urvashi Tilakdhar to NSE constitutes a formal Regulation 10(5) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This step typically follows a substantial acquisition of voting rights and is mandatory within 2 working days of the transaction or event triggering disclosure. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition method, consideration, and timeline remain to be disclosed in full via the formal letter of offer or further regulatory filings.
